data.description: Seed: Create two 8-bar sequences using the same leitmotif. One for use in menu screens between play sessions (ambient/calm), one for in a play session with action (energetic). Presented as MIDI files with a full range of instruments. Also provide a How To document covering all aspects of its creation including voicing. --priority medium
data.title: Two 8-bar game sequences from a shared leitmotif: menu (between sessions) and action (in-session), delivered as MIDI + How To doc
